text:
Bowl about 15 cm wide. It holds roughly 8 chunks of cantaloupe or papaya (about 150 g) on a bed of white rice, maybe 100 g, partly hidden. Estimated energy: fruit at about 0.35 kcal/g gives about 50 kcal, and rice at 1.3 kcal/g gives about 130 kcal, for roughly 180 kcal. If the white layer is yogurt or coconut rice instead, the total would be similar.
